title.narrative: FJI-RS-003 Mainstreaming Adaptation Planning at the Local Level in Fiji

description.narrative: Submit a proposal to GCF Readiness for adaptation. Fiji already has a National Adaptation Plan. Fiji government would now like to integrate adaptation at the local level: in the town development planning and investment plans.A pilot could be implemented under this funding in Savusavu, linking to the Blue Town project.
